slides.title: Less [[thirst]] in cold
slides.body: In cold weather, you often feel less thirsty than in summer. So it's easy to go hours without a sip and not even notice.

slides.title: Heated air is [[dry]]
slides.body: Indoor heating and dry winter air mean you still lose water through your breath and skin, even without sweating. You just don't see it.

items.head: Keep a bottle in sight
items.sub: On your desk, refill it at lunch

caption:
Cold days, fewer sips? 💧

You often feel less thirsty in winter, while heated indoor air keeps quietly drying things out.
Try three small habits starting tomorrow:
Start with a warm glass · Keep a bottle in sight · Pair sips with routines
